regions.today: Showers will develop over northern parts this evening with more persistent rain in the south and midlands.
regions.tonight: Rain will ease for a time tonight but it will be cloudy with outbreaks of rain returning. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees, with moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start off cloudy with outbreaks of rain. Rain will clear eastwards with sunshine and scattered showers following. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees with light to moderate southwesterly winds veering westerly.
regions.pollen: Very high on Monday and Tuesday.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Monday and Tuesday.
